49444-five-years-in-texas-or-what-you-di.title: Texas And Mexico.
49444-five-years-in-texas-or-what-you-di.creator: Thomas North.
49444-five-years-in-texas-or-what-you-di.description: A book by Thomas North.. Eulogy to the residue of the book, yet, for himself, the Author sees and feels a species of mystical connection between Mr. and himself in all his travels and experiences in Texas and Mexico. And so much the more because of his earnest prophetic endeavor to dissuade him from going there.

arxiv-1811-01648.title: Studies on gluon evolution and geometrical scaling in kinematic constrained unitarized BFKL equation: application to high-precision HERA DIS data Journal: Eur. Phys. J. C
arxiv-1811-01648.creator: P. Phukan e1,addr1, M. Lalung e2,addr1, J. K. Sarma e3,addr1
arxiv-1811-01648.description: Abstract We suggest a modified form of a unitarized BFKL equation imposing the so-called kinematic constraint on the gluon evolution in multi-Regge kinematics. The underlying nonlinear effects on the gluon evolution are investigated by solving the unitarized BFKL equation analytically.

arxiv-2102-04975.title: Non-Boolean Quantum Amplitude Amplification and Quantum Mean Estimation CCS: Theory of computation Quantum computation theory CCS: Computer systems organization Quantum computing
arxiv-2102-04975.creator: Prasanth Shyamsundar
arxiv-2102-04975.description: Abstract . This paper generalizes the quantum amplitude amplification and amplitude estimation algorithms to work with non-boolean oracles. The action of a non-boolean oracle U φ U_{\varphi} on an eigenstate | x ⟩ \Ket{x} is to apply a state-dependent phase-shift φ ⁡ ( x ) \varphi(x) .

arxiv-2110-06327.title: AC sensing using nitrogen vacancy centers in a diamond anvil cell up to 6 GPa
arxiv-2110-06327.creator: Z. Wang, C. McPherson, R. Kadado, N. Brandt, S. Edwards, W. H. Casey, N. J. Curro
arxiv-2110-06327.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Z. Wang, C. McPherson, R. Kadado, N. Brandt, S. Edwards, W. H. Casey, N. J. Curro. Nitrogen-vacancy color centers in diamond have attracted broad attention as quantum sensors for both static and dynamic magnetic, electrical, strain and thermal fields, and are particularly attractive for quantum sensing under pressure in diamond anvil cells. Optically-based nuclear magnetic resonance may be possible at pressures greater than a few GPa, and offers an attractive alternative to conventional Faraday-induction based detection.

arxiv-2201-06623.title: Extremal clustering and cluster counting for spatial random fields
arxiv-2201-06623.creator: ARAnders Rønn–Nielsenabel=e1, mark]aro.fi@cbs.dk, MSMads Stehrabel=e2, mark]mast.fi@cbs.dk
arxiv-2201-06623.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by ARAnders Rønn–Nielsenabel=e1, mark]aro.fi@cbs.dk, MSMads Stehrabel=e2, mark]mast.fi@cbs.dk. We consider a stationary random field indexed by an increasing sequence of subsets of ℤ d {\mathbb{Z}^{d}} obeying a very broad geometrical assumption on how the sequence expands. Under certain mixing and local conditions, we show how the tail distribution of the individual variables relates to the tail behavior of the maximum of the field over the index sets in the limit as the index sets expand.

arxiv-2307-12441.title: Swarm-Based Optimization with Random Descent Thanks: Acknowledgment. Research was supported in part by ONR grant N00014-2112773.
arxiv-2307-12441.creator: Eitan Tadmor, Anil Zenginoglu
arxiv-2307-12441.description: Abstract . We extend our study of the swarm-based gradient descent method for non-convex optimization, [ 15 ] , to allow random descent directions. We recall that the swarm-based approach consists of a swarm of agents, each identified with a position, 𝐱 \mathbf{x} , and mass, m m .

arxiv-2309-06990.title: Reheating constraints on modified quadratic chaotic inflation
arxiv-2309-06990.creator: Sudhava Yadav, Rajesh Goswami, K.K Venkataratnam, Urjit A. Yajnik
arxiv-2309-06990.description: Abstract The Reheating era of inflationary universe can be parameterized by various parameters like reheating temperature T re T_{\text{re}} , reheating duration N re N_{\text{re}} and average equation of state parameter ω ¯ re \overline{\omega}_{\text{re}} , which can be constrained by observationally feasible values of scalar power spectral amplitude A s A_{\text{s}} and spectral index n s n_{\text{s}} .

arxiv-2309-13318.title: Spanish Resource Grammar version 2023
arxiv-2309-13318.description: Abstract We present the latest version of the Spanish Resource Grammar (SRG), a grammar of Spanish implemented in the HPSG formalism. Such grammars encode a complex set of hypotheses about syntax making them a resource for empirical testing of linguistic theory.

arxiv-2510-02486.title: A physically-informed sea spray generation model for splashing waves
arxiv-2510-02486.creator: Kaitao Tang, Thomas A.A. Adcock, Wouter Mostert
arxiv-2510-02486.description: Abstract Large sea spray drops - of up to 2mm in diameter - constitute one of the most uncertain factors controlling the intensification of hurricanes and severe storms because their generation mechanisms are not understood. Wave splashing produces among the largest spray drops, but observational data regarding these drops is difficult to obtain and hence cannot inform current modelling efforts.

arxiv-2601-00975.title: Website with interactive visualization of multivariate astronomical time series
arxiv-2601-00975.creator: M. Volkov ⋆ \star, M. Demianenko ⋆ \star, D. Matveev, K. A. Grishin, I. V. Chilingarian
arxiv-2601-00975.description: Abstract Light curves represent astronomical time series of flux measured across one or more photometric bands. With the rapid growth of large-scale sky surveys, time-domain astronomy has become an essential area of modern astrophysical research. Interactive visualization of extensive light-curve datasets plays a key role in exploring transient phenomena and in planning large follow-up campaigns.

pmc-10604710.title: Smoking Induces a Decline in Semen Quality and the Activation of Stress Response Pathways in Sperm
pmc-10604710.creator: Magda Carvalho Henriques, Joana Santiago, António Patrício, Maria Teresa Herdeiro, Susana Loureiro, Margarida Fardilha
pmc-10604710.description: Male infertility is a prevalent concern affecting couples worldwide. While genetic factors, hormonal imbalances, and reproductive system defects play significant roles, emerging evidence suggests that lifestyle choices also profoundly impact male fertility. This study aimed to explore the effects of several lifestyle factors, including tobacco and alcohol consumption, physical activity, and dietary habits, on semen quality parameters and molecular biomarkers.

pmc-10914664.title: 5-HT4 Receptor Agonist Effects on Functional Connectivity in the Human Brain: Implications for Procognitive Action
pmc-10914664.creator: Angharad N de Cates, Marieke AG Martens, Lucy C Wright, Daisy Gibson, Gershon Spitz, Cassandra D Gould van Praag, Sana Suri, Philip J Cowen, Susannah E Murphy, Catherine J Harmer
pmc-10914664.description: BackgroundCognitive deficits are often comorbid with mood disorders and can cause significant functional impairment even after resolution of the primary mood symptoms. We do not currently have pharmacological treatments that adequately address these deficits. 5-HT4 receptor agonists show promise as potential procognitive agents in animal and early human translational studies.

pmc-11431128.title: Explain Breathlessness: Could ‘Usual’ Explanations Contribute to Maladaptive Beliefs of People Living with Breathlessness?
pmc-11431128.creator: Marie T Williams, Hayley Lewthwaite, Dina Brooks, Kylie N Johnston, Nobuyasu Komasawa
pmc-11431128.description: Background: Explanations provided by healthcare professionals contribute to patient beliefs. Little is known about how healthcare professionals explain chronic breathlessness to people living with this adverse sensation. Methods: A purpose-designed survey disseminated via newsletters of Australian professional associations (physiotherapy, respiratory medicine, palliative care).

pmc-11693290.title: I? AI? EXPLORING ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE USAGE, PERSONALITY AND OTHER CHARACTERISTICS IN OLDER ADULTS
pmc-11693290.creator: Sharon Ost-Mor, Nir Wittenberg, Yossefa Birati
pmc-11693290.description: As Artificial intelligence (AI) becomes increasingly prevalent in modern society, understanding its adoption among older adults is crucial. Therefore, this study examines the relationship between AI usage, Big 5 personality traits, and positive solitude, among adults aged 60 and over in Israel.

pmc-12701947.title: Early Orthodontic and Orthopedic Interventions for Anterior Open Bite in the Mixed Dentition: A Systematic Review
pmc-12701947.creator: Asma Salih Fadul Yousif, Ahmed Fathi Farah Hassan, Leina Tarig Mohamed Ali Idress, Israa K B Elhassan, Rania Elnour, Eman Ali Mohamed Salih Omer
pmc-12701947.description: Anterior open bite (AOB) is a complex malocclusion prevalent in the mixed dentition, with multifactorial etiology involving skeletal, dental, and habitual components. Early intervention during this developmental stage is advocated to correct the malocclusion and guide growth, but the most effective and stable approaches remain debated.

pmc-12735184.title: Comparative Analysis of Environmental and Host-Associated Microbiome in Odorrana schmackeri (Auran: Ranidae): Insights into Tissue-Specific Colonization and Microbial Adaptation
pmc-12735184.creator: Dongyu Han, Ruinan Zhao, Xinyue Yang, Tonghang Wang, Zike Li, Mengyao Zhu, Qingya Yang, Yanfu Qu, Xiaohong Chen, Zhuo Chen
pmc-12735184.description: Amphibian microbial communities are known to be shaped by host physiology and environmental factors, yet the relative roles of sexual dimorphism and tissue specialization remain poorly understood. Using 16S rRNA gene sequencing, we compared the gastrointestinal and integumentary microbiomes of a monomorphic Chinese frog population, Odorrana schmackeri, inhabiting identical montane streams.

pmc-13187256.title: Glycosylation-driven necroptosis in retinal degeneration: dual rescue by AAV8 gene therapy and RIPK1 inhibition
pmc-13187256.creator: Jia-Ying Chien, Peng Yeong Woon, Hsien-Yang Tsai, Mei-Ling Peng, Shi-Huang Lee, Siu-Fung Chau, Yu-Chen Chen, Wai-Man Cheang, Ching-Yen Tsai, Shun-Ping Huang
pmc-13187256.description: Glycosylation defects are increasingly implicated across neurodegenerative diseases, yet the mechanism by which perturbed O-mannosylation drives neuronal death—and how to reverse it—remains unclear. Here we show that a disease-associated POMGnT1 L120R mutation produces widespread retinal neurodegeneration by coupling metabolic collapse to necroptosis.

pmc-13386671.title: Adoptive transfer of VSIG4+ macrophages interrupts the CCL2-CCR2 inflammatory amplification loop to mitigate acetaminophen-induced acute liver injury in murine and human organoid models
pmc-13386671.creator: Biao Duan, Jun Chen, Guan Liu, Jiacheng Lin, Shiyu Yang, Xiaoni Kong, Weifang Rong, Weifeng Tan
pmc-13386671.description: BackgroundAcute liver injury (ALI) can rapidly progress to life-threatening acute liver failure. Liver transplantation remains the only definitive treatment, despite critical donor shortages. Macrophage-based therapies have shown promise in ALI but face challenges related to subset imprecision and limited humanized validation.

pmc-13579284.title: Carrier-free nanoparticles in microneedles disrupt endosomal acidification suppress ferroptosis in radiation-induced oral mucositis
pmc-13579284.creator: Yanxuan Xiao, Pengcheng Sun, Wenjie Xu, Xinyan Hao, Tiantian Tang, Xinying Liu, Hai Huang, Zhaojian Gong, Junyong Wu
pmc-13579284.description: Radiation-induced oral mucositis (RIOM) is the most common complication in patients receiving radiotherapy for head and neck, to which ferroptosis is an important contributor. Transferrin receptor (TFRC) -mediated endocytosis is a critical source of iron. Accordingly, we proposed that inhibiting ferroptosis by disrupting TFRC mediated-iron uptake.

pmc-13675375.title: ASO Author Reflections: Multi-Modal Prehabilitation and Outcomes After Gastroesophageal Cancer Surgery: A Cohort Study of Pulmonary Complications and Resilience to Major Postoperative Events
pmc-13675375.creator: David S. Liu, Jesse Turner, Ashley Bigaran
pmc-13675375.description:
A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). prehabilitation including physical, nutritional, psychological, and medical interventions have emerged as bundled mechanisms to improve bio-psychological resilience in those preparing for high-risk esophago-gastric surgery.2,3 Its impact on perioperative outcomes was evaluated in this study. Present

This single center registry-based trial of 164 participants (control: n = 121, prehabilitation: n = 43) demonstrated that multimodal prehabilitation improved physical fitness and decreased malnutrition rates. This was associated with reduced postoperative respiratory, cardiac, hepatic, and renal complications compared with controls.

pmc-13688072.title: Cortical Thickness and White Matter Surface Morphology in Tourette Syndrome: A Cohort Study
pmc-13688072.creator: Sahar Delavari, Adam C Frank, Ravi Bansal, Flora M Vaccarino, Robert A King, Paul Lombroso, Lawrence Scahill, James F Leckman, Bradley S Peterson
pmc-13688072.description: ObjectiveTo examine cortical thickness and white matter surface morphology in a large sample of individuals with Tourette syndrome (TS) and neurotypical controls across the lifespan, and to assess associations with symptom severity, comorbidities, and medication use.MethodsCross‐sectional neuroimaging cohort study utilizing high‐resolution, T1‐weighted magnetic resonance imaging scans obtained in 264 participants (151 TS, 113 neurotypical controls), aged 6–63 years.
